name: Extra Space Storage
description: Extra Space is the largest self-storage operator in the US: it owned or operated 4,281 stores (about 330.4 million sq ft, 2.9 million units) in 43 states and DC at 2025-12-31, of which about 2,425 it owns in whole or part and 1,856 it manages for third-party owners. About 86 percent of its $3.38B 2025 revenue is rent on its own stores, paid monthly by roughly 2.6 million tenants, mostly month-to-month, so rates can be raised at least annually. It also earns reinsurance premiums on tenants' goods-protection plans (10 percent of revenue, with an 80 percent margin), management fees on third-party stores, and interest on a $1.5B bridge-loan book to other storage owners. Same-store occupancy was 94.2 percent at 2026-06-30.

gics.note: Sector and sub-industry per Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies'; industry group and industry not given there.

hq.note: 2795 Cottonwood Parkway, Suite 400 (SEC EDGAR business address)

businessLines.name: Self-storage operations
businessLines.how: Individuals and businesses rent storage units month-to-month, with rates raised at least annually on existing tenants and set dynamically for new customers (real-time pricing and discount management); profit is rent less payroll, marketing, property tax and upkeep, so it moves with occupancy, street rates and property taxes.
businessLines.description: Rental of storage units at wholly-owned stores (2,026 wholly-owned, 11 in consolidated joint ventures and 409 in unconsolidated joint ventures at 2026-06-30), plus the rest of the 4,410-store network that it manages.

revenue.note: 'Property rental' revenue; FY2024 $2,803.3M; FY2023 $2,222.6M. Six months to 2026-06-30 total company revenue $1,730.2M vs $1,661.6M.

businessLines.revenueNote: 'Property rental' revenue; FY2024 $2,803.3M; FY2023 $2,222.6M. Six months to 2026-06-30 total company revenue $1,730.2M vs $1,661.6M.

operatingProfit.note: Segment revenue less segment operating expenses $918.1M. Share is of total segment NOI of about $2,261.0M (computed); margin computed.

businessLines.name: Tenant reinsurance
businessLines.how: Monthly premiums collected from tenants who choose the protection plan, recognised over the coverage period, less claims; revenue grows with the number of stores operated and tenants enrolled, and claims spike after weather events.
businessLines.description: A wholly-owned subsidiary reinsures policies that protect tenants' stored goods, sold at Extra Space-owned stores and at stores it manages for third parties; tenants can instead buy cover from an unrelated insurer.

operatingProfit.note: Computed: segment revenue $352.9M less expense $68.9M (FY2024 expense $73.9M). Shares computed against total segment NOI of about $2,261.0M.

businessLines.name: Management fees, bridge lending and other (not a reportable segment)
businessLines.how: Management fee income on third-party stores, interest and origination fees on mortgage and mezzanine bridge loans, and preferred dividends; builds the managed footprint and acquisition pipeline with little capital.
businessLines.description: Fees for managing 1,856 stores for third-party owners at 2025-12-31 (1,964 at 2026-06-30), interest and fees on a bridge-loan program to owners of stores it manages ($1.5B receivable at 2025-12-31), and dividend income on preferred stock in other storage companies.

brands.share: 4,281 stores owned and/or operated at 2025-12-31, 330.4M sq ft, about 2.9M units
